recommended_adversarial_test_cases.expectation: A small authentic subset and non-48 paragraph inventory derive all counts; no 180-clause or216-vector requirement. Original fixed adapter continues refusing it.
NFC/NFD, smart punctuation, multibyte delimiters and repeated occurrences preserve UTF8 SHA and char/byte offsets; source substitution with recomputed envelope hashes refuses at native receipt join.
Missing vector, wrong source hash/text, swapped equal-length source rows, duplicate row IDs, wrong alias role/slot, and reordered context segments refuse.
Two literal occurrences of one clause share one native vector but retain two ordered offsets/aliases; deduplication never removes occurrence structure.

Two candidate records for the same exact source/profile with conflicting vector bits or token records refuse or require an explicit exact upstream record selector; never take an arbitrary first match.
384/768 swaps, padding, trimming, bool dimensions, mock 8D vectors, historical-feature hashes, core384 and trained384 projected vectors cannot be presented as raw selected-normative native input.
Reject booleans, strings, nested vectors, NaN/Infinity, float32 overflow, wrong lengths and wrong norm without renormalizing or recomputing replacement values.

Recompute outer hashes after altering model/code revision, assets digest, producer identity, pooling, dtype, device, vector bytes or token digest: strict width-specific native evidence joins still refuse.

Incomplete token metadata, actual >512 tokens, truncated=true, padded count masquerading as active count, or relabelling768 historical8192 as actual512 refuses; no tokenization/inference performed by preparation.
Empty delimiter segments, >8 clauses, excessive rows/vector inventory/UTF8 bytes/serialized packet, too many selected IDs or missing selected IDs refuse before model access; no silent shortening.
Top-level or nested targets/gold/reference labels/teacher logits, authority true, or unknown fields refuse even after hashes are recomputed.
Duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite constants, excessive nesting and bool/int equality substitutions refuse; canonical digest conventions remain producer-specific rather than silently translated.

Wrong file pin, symlink, nonregular input, unexpected current hardlink, current owner path/origin mismatch or endpoint replacement refuses; historical bounded hardlinks use their explicit old witness policy.
Pure plan/assembly tests deny Torch/Transformers imports, encoder forwards, optimizer operations, parser/semantic-reference access and network; models-loaded/executed remainsfalse.
Mutating caller dictionaries after validation or returned descriptions cannot change saved plan/cache state or digest; dtype/recipe and source identity remain bound.
Every accepted synthetic-format fixture still reports encoder_execution_attested=false, source_semantics_verified=false, proof_authority=false, all masks0/formalnull and no default promotion.
Old source-plan/cached-runtime APIs, fixtures, selected checkpoints/preprocessing and27-owner closure remain byte-identical; focused old boundary controls pass under the same resource conditions.
